verdict.rationale: Sierra ships explicit natural-language interfaces: Ghostwriter lets users 'build or modify agents by describing how you want them to behave' via simple prompts (sierra-docs-8), Explorer lets users 'ask any question... in natural language' (sierra-docs-10), and Agent Studio can 'use AI to instantly generate journeys' from SOPs (sierra-docs-6, sierra-docs-9). This is corroborated loosely by community reports of point-and-click + description-based agent setup (sierra-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of NL-command reliability and breadth (e.g., whether all product surfaces, not just Ghostwriter/Explorer, are NL-operable), and no probe-based confirmation of an underlying API/CLI for NL-driven automation.
